doc.title: Pete Candoli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999

title: Al Vizzutti and the El Chapultepec in Denver
summary: Pete praises Al Vizzutti and recalls pressing the club owner Jerry Krantz to book him.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: I know. Well thank you. I’ve been very lucky. I’ve been in the right places. I know some players that just are marvelous, some of these stage bands, really. I remember Al Vizzutti, you know Vizzutti? © Fillius Jazz Archive -18-

What a wonderful guy and what a tremendous player, really, wonderful. And at one time I tried to play a place called El Chapultepec every year in Denver. It’s called the El Chapultepec, which is a grasshopper. And the guy who runs it is Jerry Krantz. No cover, no minimum, and he takes care of artists financially and every other way. And I said, “You know there’s a guy by the name of Alan Vizzutti, he’s just phenomenal.” He said, “Yeah I know.” I said, “Well you ought to bring him in.” He said, “Well you know, Pete, I’ve got to have some people that people know.” See I’ve been around since— And I said, “Well they’ll know him once he’s here, I mean you’ll have him back.” He said, “Oh, okay, I’ll think about it if there’s a slow thing or something.” It’s hard to get people. Then he said, “Well how do you get a record date, or how do you get your own recording?” I said there’s no real rule.
Nowadays people pay for it themselves.
